john-harabedian.text: Authored AB 493 (chaptered), requiring financial institutions to pay at least 2% simple annual interest on hazard insurance proceeds held in loss draft accounts while a home is rebuilt, aimed at disaster victims such as wildfire survivors.
Authored AB 238 (Mortgage Forbearance Act), requiring mortgage servicers to offer wildfire-affected borrowers forbearance of up to 12 months, with no late fees and no foreclosure during forbearance.
Authored AB 2576, which adds State Historic Resources Inventory-listed historic sites and districts to the properties excluded from transit-oriented housing development streamlining provisions.
Authored AB 1642, directing the Department of Toxic Substances Control to set lead and asbestos screening and remediation standards for properties after wildfires.
